About the role
DevRev is hiring a Senior Product Manager for the Computer Data and Analytics Platform – a hands-on product leader who will own the trusted data foundation that makes Computer precise, useful, and safe across every experience.
Computer should not merely report on work. It should understand customer, product, and operational context; reason across it; and help people and agents take the right action. The Computer Data and Analytics Platform makes that possible through a unified, governed, low-latency data layer that turns data from DevRev and connected systems into durable context for humans, applications, analytics experiences, and AI agents.
You will define how data is captured, modeled, governed, queried, and activated across DevRev. The platform will support operational reporting and embedded analytics, while also enabling grounded, context-rich agentic conversations in Computer – helping users ask questions, investigate work, receive trusted answers, and take safe actions in the flow of work.
This is a unique opportunity to build the foundation for an AI-native operating system – where customer context, product telemetry, structured records, events, and machine reasoning converge.
What you'll do
Lead the Computer Data and Analytics Platform vision and roadmap - Define and scale the platform that transforms operational and product data into reliable, reusable context for analytics, dashboards, applications, APIs, workflows, and Computer. Set a clear strategy for data modeling, query experiences, data freshness, governance, and activation.
Build trusted, AI agent-ready data foundations - Own the product direction for a platform that preserves source-of-record fidelity while making data easy to discover, understand, and use. Shape the abstractions that let Computer and people work with data confidently – including lineage, permissions, access controls, quality signals, and semantic definitions.
Define the data lifecycle from capture to activation - Guide the end-to-end path from source systems and event capture through change data capture, durable query representations, and governed serving layers. Ensure the platform supports real-time and historical workloads without forcing every experience to depend on a single data store or query engine.
Enable precise answers and safe actions with Computer - Partner with the AI platform to make natural-language data experiences dependable. Drive capabilities that allow Computer to retrieve grounded context, generate useful analysis and visualizations, and execute approved actions through clear permissions, guardrails, and auditability.
Build high-performance, flexible query experiences - Shape the experience for interactive analysis, embedded analytics, and developer workflows. Leverage in-process and local query technologies, including DuckDB where appropriate, to deliver responsive, secure experiences for applications, notebooks, and agents.
Design for multiple personas and levels of abstraction - Serve developers, data and product teams, support leaders, GTM teams, and operators. Provide opinionated defaults and ready-to-use experiences for common workflows, while preserving composability for technical users building applications, integrations, and custom data products.
Champion a platform-grade developer experience - Treat data as a core developer product. Prioritize intuitive APIs and SDKs, documentation, modular primitives, observability, extensibility, and a clear path from prototype to production.
Drive platform-wide interoperability - Ensure the Computer Data and Analytics Platform works seamlessly with DevRev’s product data, customer records, connected systems, applications, workflows, and AI agents. Establish the shared data contracts and platform capabilities that power a complete customer and product understanding.

What you'll bring
8+ years of product management or complementary experience building data platforms, developer platforms, analytics products, AI products, or infrastructure products.
Experience defining products that span data ingestion, data modeling, data quality, governance, querying, and downstream activation.
Strong understanding of modern data architectures, including source systems, event streams, change data capture, lakehouse-style storage, query engines, and serving layers.
Familiarity with embedded and in-process analytics, such as DuckDB, and the trade-offs between local, operational, and centralized query patterns.
Practical understanding of AI-native data experiences, including grounded retrieval, natural-language querying, Text-to-SQL, evaluation, permissions, and safe action execution.
Ability to design products that serve both technical and non-technical users without compromising trust, usability, or extensibility.
A record of partnering deeply with engineering, design, AI/ML, security, and go-to-market teams to ship reliable, scalable platform products.
Strong product judgment in ambiguous, technical environments – with the ability to turn an architectural direction into clear customer value, milestones, and adoption measures.

Why This Role
You will define the data foundation that makes Computer increasingly capable over time. Your work will enable a future where every interaction can benefit from complete, trusted context: Computer can answer with evidence, surface insights at the right moment, automate approved workflows, and help teams build faster on a shared data platform.
This is not a traditional BI role. It is a chance to build the connective layer between DevRev’s product, customer, and operational data – and the intelligent experiences that turn that data into outcomes.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to join Firefly group. As part of our ambitious team, you will develop a business around Generative-AI surfaces for Adobe, driving innovation and crafting a flawless user experience. Experience working on AI-based products is highly desirable.

Roadmap and Launch

Build detailed product requirements and specifications
Plan capacity based on estimated demand and goals
Support launch phases including Private/Public Beta and GA
Collaborate with go-to-market teams to ensure efficient product launch initiatives

Research Partnership

Analyze

Track critical metrics to measure performance, usage, and uptime

8-10 years of product management experience, preferably in a large technology company

Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

We are Reckitt

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

Information Technology & Digital

In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.

Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.

Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. About The Role

The role ensures clear product vision, roadmap ownership, and strong value delivery, translating Genesis objectives into well‑defined product outcomes aligned to procurement priorities. This includes shaping product strategy, defining success metrics, prioritising backlogs, and ensuring products are delivered in line with agreed objectives, timelines, and governance standards.

Your responsibilities

Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for multiple AI products across the Source‑to‑Pay lifecycle (e.g. sourcing, negotiations, contracting, supplier management, buying, savings tracking).

Translate Procurement strategy and pain points into high‑value AI use cases, balancing innovation with practical business impact.

Shape and prioritise the product backlog, working closely with Product Owners, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, AI Engineers, Business Analysts, and Architects.

Manage and govern relationships with external partners, ensuring outcomes, delivery quality, and knowledge Innovation and Thought Leadership

Stay current with AI trends including LLMs, agent‑based systems, optimisation algorithms, game theory, and decision intelligence, and assess their relevance for Procurement.

Champion experimentation and learning, helping the organisation move from proof‑of‑concept to scaled value.

Act as an AI evangelist within Procurement, able to simplify complex concepts for non‑technical stakeholders.

The experience we're looking for

Skills/Experiences

Essential

12+ years of experience as a Product Manager delivering digital or AI driven products.
Strong Procurement domain knowledge, particularly across the Source to Pay process.
Solid understanding of AI and analytics concepts, including LLMs, ML models, algorithms, and data pipelines (hands on coding not required).
Ability to work effectively in complex, matrixed environments with global stakeholders.
Experience working with external vendors and partners to deliver technology products.

Desirable

Experience delivering AI products in procurement, supply chain, or enterprise functions.
Familiarity with concepts such as agentic AI, optimisation, simulation, and game theory.
Experience operating within Agile / product led delivery models.
Background in transformation, innovation, or advanced analytics programmes.

Technical / Professional Qualifications:

Essential

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Supply Chain, Procurement, or a related discipline.
Proven experience using product and delivery management tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira, Productboard, or similar) to manage backlogs, roadmaps, and delivery flow.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint (executive storytelling), PowerBI (analysis and value tracking), and Word.
Solid understanding of digital and AI product lifecycles, including discovery, MVP delivery, scaling, and benefits realisation.

Desired

Certification or formal training in Product Management (e.g., Pragmatic, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, Scrum Product Owner).
Certification or training in Agile / Scaled Agile methodologies.
Exposure to or training in AI, analytics, or data driven products (e.g., Generative AI, Machine Learning fundamentals)

The skills for success

Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership, AI Product Management, Procurement (Source-to-Pay) Expertise, Stakeholder Management & Alignment, Backlog Prioritisation & Value Definition, Agile / Product-led Delivery, Data & AI Concepts (LLMs, ML, Data Pipelines), End-to-End Product Lifecycle Management (Discovery to Scale), Vendor & Partner Management, Business Value Realisation & KPIs, Cross-functional Leadership (Tech & Business Teams), Risk & Governance Management, Decision Making & Problem Solving, Communication & Executive Storytelling, Tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Productboard, PowerBI)

What we offer

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.

Equality

We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Senior Product Manager, Search, Indexing and Query

Couchbase | Product Organisation | Bangalore, India | Reports to VP of AI Product Management

About The Role

Couchbase is building the operational data platform for AI. Search, indexing and query are the core of it — how data is found, filtered, ranked and returned is what determines whether an application, or an agent, can actually use the data underneath. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own that surface area across Capella and Couchbase Enterprise: the SQL++ query experience, secondary indexing, full-text search, and vector and hybrid search.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who wants to do the work at the Senior level — write the PRFAQ, sit with the customer, push the tradeoff, ship the capability, and own the outcome after launch. Reporting to the VP of AI Product Management, you will partner closely with the query, indexing and search engineering teams, with sales and GTM, and with the broader AI organization.

You do not need to have shipped a query engine or a search product before. We are hiring for the underlying capability, not the resume line — see “Who This Role Is Open To” below.

What You Will Own

Search, indexing and query as a product surface: End-to-end ownership of how customers express and satisfy a query on Couchbase — SQL++ query, global secondary indexes, full-text search, and vector and hybrid search. The roadmap in your area, the PRFAQs and PRDs, the launch, the adoption, and the iteration after launch.

Retrieval for AI applications: Make Couchbase the retrieval layer that RAG applications and agents actually use — hybrid search relevance, metadata filtering, recall and freshness, and cost per query. Work with the wider AI portfolio so retrieval composes with the rest of the platform rather than sitting beside it.

Developer experience for query and indexing: How a developer writes a query, gets an index recommendation, debugs a slow plan, and understands what a query costs. Reduce the number of things a developer has to know before their first query is fast.

Performance, cost and benchmark credibility: Own the performance story for your area. Reproducible benchmarks the field can stand behind, a defensible cost and TCO narrative against MongoDB, Elastic, Postgres and pgvector, and dedicated vector stores, and a clear point of view on where Couchbase wins and where it does not.

Working backwards from the customer: Start with the customer and work backwards. Write the PRFAQ before any code is written. Validate with real, named enterprise customers. Make clear tradeoff calls about what to build and what to defer based on what the enterprise ICP universally needs — not features chasing competitors or one-off requests outside the ICP.

Engineering partnership: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the query, indexing and search engineering teams. Earn their trust by being technically credible, decisive on scope, and clear on the why. Own the PRD as a living document, not a one-time artifact. Hold the bar on quality, scope, and timing through to launch.

Customer and design partner engagement: Run design partner programs for the capabilities you own. Bring real customer voice into roadmap decisions and back to the broader team. Help build a pipeline of named reference customers willing to talk publicly about what they have shipped.

Cross-portfolio collaboration: Coordinate across Core Database, Capella, Analytics, Mobile and Edge, and the AI Specialist team so the capabilities you own compose cleanly with the rest of the platform. Bring a build-vs-partner point of view to your area.

Sales and GTM partnership: Equip sales, sales engineering, PMM, and partner GTM with what they need to win on search, indexing and query — positioning, demos, competitive context, benchmark data, customer proof points. Be the product owner in deals where the technical depth matters.

External voice: Contribute as the product owner in customer briefings, webinars, blog posts, documentation, and enablement content for the capabilities you own. Support analyst engagements and keynote content led by the Principal PM, PMM, and AR.

AI-driven PM practice: Use AI deeply and visibly in your own product management work — research, PRFAQ drafting, customer synthesis, competitive analysis, benchmark analysis, engineering collaboration. Adopt and contribute to the team’s AI-driven PM and AI-DLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) practices in day-to-day execution.

Raising the bar: Share what works. Contribute to PRFAQ and PRD standards, interview loops, and onboarding. Mentor associate and early-career PMs as the team grows.

What You Will Deliver

PRFAQs and PRDs for the capabilities you own, validated with named enterprise customers before engineering starts.

Shipped capabilities across query, indexing and search with measurable adoption and at least one named reference customer per major launch.

A published, reproducible performance and cost position for your area that sales and engineering both stand behind.

Clear, defensible tradeoff decisions visible to engineering, sales, and GTM. The team knows what is in, what is out, and why.

Sales and GTM enablement that the field actually uses — measured by pipeline influence and win-rate signals, not enablement-decks-produced.

Contributions to the broader platform narrative — customer-facing content, blog posts, and documentation in partnership with the AI Specialist team, PMM, and AR.

Visible AI-driven PM practice — concrete examples of AI-DLC in your daily work that the rest of the team can learn from.

Must Have

Seven or more years in product management, with at least three on a technical platform — database, data infrastructure, search, analytics, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or AI infrastructure.

Systems depth. You can reason about latency, throughput, recall, index structures, query plans, memory and storage tradeoffs, and cost per operation. Given a benchmark or a slow query, you know what to ask next.

Customer obsession and working-backwards rigor: You start with the customer and work backwards. You write PRFAQs before code. You can tell which feature requests reflect universal ICP needs and which are noise, and you make the call clearly.

Engineering credibility: Engineers want to work with you. You hold your own on architecture, are decisive on scope, and own the why behind every tradeoff.

Cross-functional trust: Sales trusts your roadmap. GTM trusts your enablement. Marketing trusts your narrative. You build durable working relationships outside your own team.

AI-driven PM practice: You already use AI in your own PM work — research, PRFAQ drafting, customer synthesis, competitive analysis — and you can point to concrete examples.

Description

What if running an e-commerce business could become dramatically simpler — with AI helping sellers manage orders, inventory, pricing and operations across every channel they sell on?

Amazon Smart Commerce is looking for a Principal Product Manager - Tech to lead SmartHub (including the team of PMs), our multi-channel commerce operations platform. SmartHub brings together orders, inventory, catalog, returns, warehousing and business insights across marketplaces and D2C channels into a single system, helping businesses operate at scale without navigating multiple disconnected tools.

We are now at an exciting inflection point. Advances in generative and agentic AI create an opportunity to fundamentally rethink how sellers operate their businesses — moving from dashboards and workflows that tell sellers what happened, toward intelligent experiences that understand their business, identify what needs attention, recommend actions and increasingly execute work on their behalf.

As the Principal PM for SmartHub, you will define this next chapter. You will own the long-term product vision and roadmap for SmartHub and lead important horizontal capabilities such as pricing that span the broader Smart Commerce portfolio.

This is a role for a product builder who enjoys solving complex platform problems, operating in ambiguity and translating emerging technology into simple products that deliver measurable customer and business impact.

Key job responsibilities

Own the product vision, strategy and roadmap for SmartHub, Amazon Smart Commerce's multi-channel operations platform spanning order management, inventory, catalog, returns, warehousing and analytics.

Define how AI and agentic experiences can transform commerce operations — helping businesses move from manually operating software toward systems that understand business context, surface opportunities and risks, recommend decisions and automate repetitive work.

Reimagine high-frequency seller workflows such as order processing, inventory management, exception handling, returns and pricing to make operating across multiple sales channels dramatically simpler.

Lead horizontal product capabilities such as pricing that can create leverage across SmartHub and the broader Smart Commerce portfolio.

Develop a deep understanding of sellers ranging from emerging businesses to high-volume brands, including the operators who use SmartHub every day in warehouses and back offices.

Use customer research, product data and business insights to identify the highest-value problems and translate them into simple, scalable product experiences.

Partner deeply with engineering, science and UX teams on complex platform and AI problems, making thoughtful trade-offs across customer experience, reliability, scalability and speed.

Define and drive metrics across adoption, engagement, operational efficiency, seller experience and business impact.

Work across Amazon and external commerce ecosystems to build integrations and capabilities that allow businesses to operate seamlessly across marketplaces and D2C channels.

Influence senior leaders and partner teams across organizational boundaries to establish long-term product and technology direction.

Raise the product management bar through strong product judgment, first-principles thinking, clear written narratives and mentorship of other product leaders.

A day in the life

You might start the day speaking with a seller or warehouse operator processing thousands of orders across Amazon, Flipkart and their own website, identifying where manual work and exceptions slow them down. Later, you could work with engineers and scientists on an AI agent that detects inventory risks or automates an operational workflow, review adoption and reliability metrics with the team, and then align senior leaders on a multi-year product strategy. You will move fluidly between warehouse-floor details, customer experience, platform architecture, AI possibilities and business strategy.

About The Team

Amazon Smart Commerce is building the technology infrastructure for agentic commerce that helps businesses sell and operate wherever their customers shop.

SmartHub is our multi-channel operations platform, helping sellers bring orders, inventory, catalog, returns and business insights from multiple marketplaces and D2C channels into one system. It is built for the operational realities of commerce — high-volume events, warehouse workflows, complex integrations and businesses that cannot afford downtime.

We believe AI creates an opportunity to reinvent this category. Our ambition is to evolve from software that helps sellers manage workflows to an intelligent commerce operating system that helps them run and grow their businesses.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience technical product management

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Description

Join Amazon Pharmacy's Supply Chain team and shape the systems that determine how medications reach patients. You will define product strategy and drive performance for the buying and inventory planning systems at the core of the pharmacy supply chain: procurement systems that decide what to buy and when under expiry and regulatory constraints, inventory planning that sets optimal stock levels across the network, and placement algorithms that position inventory across fulfillment centers. These systems are informed by demand forecasts that predict prescription volume, but your focus is turning that signal into smart purchasing and inventory decisions.

Pharmacy supply chains are unlike retail: demand is primarily driven by prescriptions (not browsing), products expire, controlled substances require compliance layers, and regulations vary by state. Every buying and inventory decision you define and measure operates under these constraints.

We are looking for a dynamic, analytically rigorous Senior Product Manager - Tech to own the product strategy for how Amazon Pharmacy determines optimal inventory levels, decides what and when to buy, simulates network decisions, and identifies unhealthy inventory — with demand forecasting as a key input to those decisions. You will define the problems, shape the solutions, and drive outcomes across these domains — working directly with engineers and scientists building the underlying optimization and ML systems.

Key job responsibilities

Define the product vision and multi-year roadmap for pharmacy supply chain systems: procurement, inventory placement and capacity planning
Translate complex supply chain and healthcare constraints (expiry, controlled substances, state regulations) into product requirements that engineering teams can build against
Design and own the end-to-end metrics framework for pharmacy supply chain health within your domain
Work with Operations, Compliance, Vendor Management, Fulfillment, Finance, and In-Stock partners to provide solutions and drive improvements
Partner with Applied Scientists and ML Engineers to define success criteria for forecasting models, optimization algorithms, and automated decision systems
Influence without authority across multiple teams and organizations to drive outcomes in a matrixed environment

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics, computer science, operations research, business analytics, information systems or equivalent
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience managing technical products or online services
Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics
Experience in healthcare, pharmacy, or regulated supply chains
Experience with ML/AI product management — defining success criteria for models, managing model lifecycle, A/B testing ML systems

Own the complete Digital twin solution lifecycle – identifying the market opportunities, defining the value proposition, solutioning with customers & partners and measuring the real-world business outcomes
You are the feature owner, voice of the proposition with the customer, partners & analysts

You will work horizontally across engineering, sales, pre-sales, delivery and marketing to ensure that the value propositions are positioned correctly, priced to win, and delivered in a way that creates measurable and repeatable customer value.

Key Responsibilities

Define and drive the vision, roadmap creation of value proposition for AI-led digital twins for large Data Centers / AI Factories. Develop differentiated offerings leveraging AI, Digital Twins, IoT, analytics, and automation platforms. Translate customer and market requirements into scalable solution frameworks, accelerators, and reusable offerings.

Define innovative offerings by working closely with product, delivery & GTM team and leveraging AI & Agentic AI, industry leading DC digital twin platforms and the systems provided by various OEMs providing critical equipment for Data centers (Infra, Power, Cooling, Facility operations etc.). 

Key Responsibilities:
Value proposition: Own and continuously refine the value proposition for digital twins in data center. Map product capabilities to specific customer pain points and quantify the business case & ROI framework
Solution design: Lead end-to-end solutioning with customers and partners. Define the integration architectures with customer systems to the digital twin platform
Pre-sales & deal support: Engage directly in strategic deals – lead solution demonstration, respond to RFPs/RFIs, present to customers and develop solution proposals
Customer co-creation: Run structured discovery workshops, and co-innovation programs with key customers
Partner & ecosystem solutioning: Define and manage solution partner relationships and GTM playbooks with strategic partners
Competitive & market intelligence: Track competitor positioning, analyst coverage and adjacent technology trends. Translate market signals into positioning and roadmap input
Thought leadership: Represent HCLTech in industry forums, analyst interactions, partner ecosystems, and strategic customer engagements.


Required Qualifications & Expertise

12-19 years of relevant experience, with at least 10 years in data center operations, infrastructure engineering or DCIM/BMS/Digital Twin product management in a large enterprise or hyperscale environment
Experience in one or more of the following domains:
Direct and hands-on experience across the phases of data center – Design & Build, Planning, Operations and Optimization
Deep understanding on the design tools (like BIM/Revit), Simulation (CFD/Airflow), Virtual commissioning, Capacity planning, Hot/Cold aisle management, Power stranding & scheduled maintenance cycles
Deep working knowledge of DCIM platforms (Sunbird DCIM, Nlyte, Schneider Ecostruxure IT etc.), familiarity with BMS systems (JCI, Siemens), understanding of EPMS (Schneider Ecostruxure Power, ABB Ability, Eaton Power Xpert)
Understanding of cabling and network topology
Strong understanding of data and analytics fundamentals, IoT data pipeline, OT control systems, sensors integration, messaging protocols and how AI is applied to the infrastructure operations (AI Ops, Predictive maintenance)
Driven Sustainability and energy optimization initiatives
Experience in leading executive-level customer conversations in a data center / critical infrastructure context.
Industry certifications: CDCP / CDCS / CDCMP, RCDD, or equivalent. PMP or SAFe/Agile product certifications are plus


Preferred Qualifications

Experience in hyperscaler (AWS, Microsoft, GCP, Meta), large colocation (Equinix, Digital Realty), DC OEMs & platforms (Schneider Electric, Eaton, Vertiv, Carrier, JCI, Bentley) or enterprise multi-site DC environment
Exposure to high-fidelity virtual twin with NVIDIA Omniverse, simulation tools (Cadence, Ansys), and IOT platforms (AWS, Azure)
Knowledge of OT cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443, NIST CSF)
Experience with sustainability and decarbonization roadmaps, carbon reporting (GHG protocol)
Global exposure and experience working with cross-functional teams across geographies.

Success Metrics for the Role

Creation of differentiated HCLTech value proposition for digital twins in data center
Pipeline creation and strategic deal influence
Customer adoption and ecosystem partnerships
GTM readiness and solution commercialization
Industry visibility and innovation leadership
Measurable business growth in the data center solutions segment

About Us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

About the Role
We're looking for an experienced, product-first thinker to own the end-to-end product strategy, design, and delivery of an AI-native Network Testing and Validation Platform focused on Drive Testing, Probe Testing, automated network testing, and network performance analysis.
You will shape a product that enables telecom operators, network teams, and service providers to plan, execute, automate, and analyze network testing across 4G, 5G, and evolving network environments. The platform will unify drive testing, active and passive probe testing, network telemetry, OSS data, geospatial intelligence, and customer-experience signals into a single testing and validation ecosystem. Experience with mobile SDK-based network data collection, passive data pipelines, device telemetry, or crowdsourced network-performance platforms will be valuable.
The product vision is to transform traditional network testing from manual, field-intensive, and periodic testing into a more automated, continuous, intelligent, and data-driven testing model.

Key Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Roadmap
Build and own a product roadmap grounded in structured discovery: Jobs-to-be-Done, outcome-driven frameworks, and continuous customer evidence
Define clear problem statements, opportunity hypotheses, and measurable success metrics (OKRs, KPIs) for every initiative
Create compelling business cases with explicit ROI, adoption, and value-realization criteria
Identify market opportunities across enterprise operations, managed services, and infrastructure markets; drive positioning and GTM strategy
Product Build & Execution
Lead agile ceremonies (sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives) with a bias toward continuous delivery and validated learning
Write sharp, unambiguous PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria — bridging operator workflows and engineering implementation
Drive product decisions with data: usage telemetry, funnel metrics, and A/B testing where applicable
Manage cross- Manage cross-pillar dependencies across Drive Test, Probe, Mobile App/SDK, and Analytics — ensuring coherent workflows and data flows end-to-end.
AI-Powered Network Testing & Automation
Own the end-to-end productization of AI capabilities across network testing — from identifying use cases and defining requirements to feature design, development, integration, rollout, and adoption.
Build AI-driven features that automatically analyze drive-test, probe-test, network events, alarms, and performance data to identify anomalies and service-impacting issues.
Develop Automated Root Cause Analysis (RCA) capabilities that correlate events, alarms, KPIs, topology, configuration changes, and test results to determine probable root causes.
Build intelligent closed-loop validation where the platform detects an issue, triggers the appropriate drive/probe test, analyzes the result, recommends or initiates remediation, and automatically re-tests to validate resolution.
Go-to-Market & Stakeholder Alignment
Design and implement pricing strategies: tiered licensing, consumption-based SaaS, and value-based models
Collaborate with Sales to develop value propositions, competitive differentiation, and sales enablement materials (battle cards, solution briefs)
Drive alignment across Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Support
Communicate product vision with strong storytelling — simplifying complex automation and AI concepts for business stakeholders
Qualifications
MBA or advanced degree from a Tier-1 institution, or equivalent demonstrated impact.
8–15 years of Product Management experience in B2B enterprise software; Telecom, Network Testing, OSS, Network Assurance, or Operations Automation strongly preferred.

ABOUT DBMCI ONE

DBMCI One is a learning platform for medical students and doctors, a product of NHPL (Neuroglia Health Private Limited), a subsidiary of M3, Inc., Japan's largest healthcare company, listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

NHPL is also the company behind Marrow, India's largest and most trusted learning platform for NEET PG preparation.

DBMCI One brings together the legacy of Dr. Bhatia's Medical Coaching Institute, trusted by generations of medical aspirants, with the product velocity and data discipline of a modern tech company. We are building the definitive learning platform for India's next generation of doctors: one that adapts to how each aspirant learns, making the journey from preparation to practice measurably better.

The stakes are real. The ambition is bigger.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Product Manager to own the learner growth and engagement charter at DBMCI One. This is not a coordination role. It is a high-ownership position where you define what keeps a medical student coming back every day, what drives them from trial to deep engagement, and what ultimately makes them succeed.

You are joining at an inflection point. The habits and learning outcomes you shape today will determine how thousands of medical students learn, and in turn, how they diagnose, treat, and care for millions of patients tomorrow.

You will work hand-in-hand with Engineering, Design, Content, Data, and Marketing to ship a product that moves real numbers and real lives.

AI is not a tool you will be asked to explore here. It is the default. You are expected to prototype, automate, and iterate using AI natively from day one.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Own the full growth loop: Activation Engagement Habit Formation Retention for DBMCI One learners across platforms.
  • Define and drive the product roadmap for learner-facing features, from discovery through experimentation, launch, and post-launch iteration.
  • Use AI-assisted prototyping and vibe-coding tools to independently build and test product ideas, reducing dependence on full engineering cycles for early validation.
  • Design and run GTM experiments: scope the hypothesis, build a lean version, get it in front of real users, gather feedback, and iterate fast before committing to a full build.
  • Design and run A/B experiments at pace. Test hypotheses, kill what does not work, and double down on what does.
  • Conduct structured user research: interviews, session analysis, and cohort studies to uncover the real reasons learners drop off or stay hooked.
  • Identify leading indicators of learner success and build features that move them, not vanity metrics.
  • Use agentic AI and automation workflows to accelerate research synthesis, user feedback analysis, and product iteration cycles.
  • Write crisp PRDs, define acceptance criteria, and partner with Engineering and Design through the full delivery cycle.
  • Own the metrics framework for your charter. Build dashboards, present to leadership, and stay fully accountable for outcomes.
  • Work closely with the Content and Academics teams to ensure product and pedagogy reinforce each other.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 2 to 4 years of Product Management experience at a tech-first company. Consumer internet, EdTech, or mobile-first products are strongly preferred.
  • Strong product thinking grounded in user behaviour. You can articulate the "why behind the why" for any user action or drop-off.
  • Hands-on data fluency: SQL, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and A/B experiment design. You live in data, not just talk about it.
  • AI fluency is non-negotiable. Proficient with AI-assisted prototyping and vibe-coding tools (Cursor, Bolt, Lovable, Replit, or similar). Practical experience with agentic AI workflows, automation, and prompt engineering applied to product work.
  • Technical fluency: You can hold a system design conversation with Engineering, understand API dependencies, and make informed build-vs-scope decisions.
  • Proven ability to run end-to-end GTM experiments: scope, build, launch, gather user feedback, and iterate with speed and structure.
  • First-principles thinker. You do not copy-paste frameworks; you reason from the user and the context up.
  • High ownership, low excuses. You move fast, learn faster, and take full responsibility for what ships and what it achieves.
  • Clear, structured communicator. You can align a cross-functional team with a well-framed problem statement and a sharp point of view.

Connect directly with HR at isha.patnaik@dbmi.edu.in if you believe you are a strong fit.

Job Summary

At Arctic Wolf, you won t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve - youll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape - but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.

If you re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We re looking for a Product Manager-Platform to be part of making this/that happen.

Position Overview and Objective

This Technical Product Manager role drives requirements, execution, and delivery for reliable, scalable data lake infrastructure and intelligent AI/ML capabilities that power Arctic Wolf s security products and platform operations. The TPM translates complex business, security, and operational needs into clear product requirements and technical specifications-initially supporting 1-2 engineering squads (scaling to 2+) across sprint planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, and milestone tracking. The role collaborates closely with Data Engineers, Data Science Engineers, Platform Architects and cross-functional stakeholders to support use cases such as log availability, telemetry analysis, threat detection, and intelligent alerting while ensuring solutions adhere to robust data security, privacy, and governance standards. The role requires foundational technical fluency in distributed data systems and AI/ML lifecycles, Agile execution, and the ability to represent data platform capabilities authoritatively to integrating teams.

Responsibilities

  • Works with senior PMs to understand how data platform infrastructure and AI-enabled capabilities align with the broader platform vision and roadmap.
  • Gathers and authors requirements, PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for data pipelines, query services, data lake access layers, and AI/ML model integration workflows. Defines project-level success criteria.
  • Owns the product backlog and delivery execution for 1-2 engineering squads (growing to 2+), managing prioritization, dependencies, risk mitigation, and on-time release milestones.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders (Platform Engineering, Data Science teams, Security Operations, and Architecture) to assess system capabilities, onstraints, and architectural trade-offs.
  • Validates, where possible, that High-Level Designs (HLDs) cover all validated use cases, data processing workflows, and performance requirements for platform features.
  • Presents direction, roadmaps, and delivery status for data platform and intelligent capabilities to development teams and consuming product stakeholders.
  • Answers authoritatively questions from teams integrating against data platform APIs, pipelines, and data access layers: what is supported today, what needs to be specified, and what is out of scope.
  • Identifies high-demand, heavy-lift platform requests, cost-optimization opportunities, and emerging AI use cases for consideration in future strategy and planning sessions.

Knowledge & Experience

  • Knowledge of Product Management discipline, requirements definition, and Agile/Scrum ceremonies and practices.
  • Educational background in Computer Science or Software Engineering, or 2-5 years of equivalent technical/product experience.
  • Foundational understanding of distributed data systems, data pipelines, relational/non-relational data modeling, REST APIs, and cloud infrastructure components (e.g., AWS, GCP).
  • Familiarity with AI/ML fundamentals and lifecycle concepts (e.g., training datasets, model evaluation metrics, inference pipelines, anomaly detection, or NLP).
  • Understanding of data governance, security, privacy, and compliance standards.
  • Begins to develop a system-level approach, understanding how data platform architecture, query performance, and indexing decisions ripple across consuming security products and operational costs.
  • Exposure to security concepts such as logging pipelines, telemetry analysis, monitoring, or threat detection systems a plus.

Complexity and Problem Solving

  • Collaborates with Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, Data Science Engineers, and internal stakeholders to maintain backlog priority, sizing, and acceptance criteria for data platform and AI enablement work.
  • Communicates and escalates unexpected delays, cross-team blockers, data quality issues, or non-prioritized asks from integrating teams.
  • Analyzes platform telemetry, query latency/throughput, data reliability metrics, and performance signals to determine the highest-value backlog items and platform optimizations.

Collaboration & Interaction

  • Partners with Engineering to define technical acceptance criteria and ensure tickets/epics are properly documented before scheduling into sprints.
  • Collaborates with consuming product teams and operational stakeholders to define success criteria and validate that data platform and AI features resolve the intended operational challenges.
  • Engages Engineering to monitor telemetry related to platform usage, storage/compute efficiency, and AI effectiveness, reporting regularly on key operational metrics.
  • Develops strong working relationships with Engineering and Data Science teams as a trusted technical subject-matter partner, and proactively collaborates with peer Product Managers as well as cross functional teams.

Why This Role

This is real technical ownership, not requirements administration. Youll partner directly with engineering on systems that the rest of the platform depends on, with genuine architectural input: reviewing HLDs, shaping tradeoffs, and building prototypes to test direction before engineering commits. Youll join a small team at the ground floor of one of the first governed AI-access layers in the security industry, with a growth path shaped by how fast this space matures, not a fixed org chart.

On-Camera Policy

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

Introduction

We are looking for a hands-on Technical Product Manager to own product strategy and measurable outcomes for the tools and workflows that power Customer Support (CS) and Trust & Safety (TnS) for Mercari.

You will identify high-impact problems, create the roadmap, write clear product requirements, manage delivery, and measure results. This role requires strong product judgment, practical use of data and AI, and the ability to bridge Japan-based stakeholders and the India engineering team in Japanese and English.

About Us

Mercari is a Japan-based C2C marketplace company founded in 2013 with the mission to "Create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy & sell." From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018 we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission.

Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U.S. We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, which is a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realize their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit. Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management.

For our services to be utilized by people worldwide; however, there is still a mountain of work ahead of us. This endeavor naturally requires the capability of the best talent and minds, and that is exactly the reason for us to launch the India Center of Excellence. With your help, we will continue to take on the world stage and strive to grow into a successful global tech company.

About Mercari India

Established in Bengaluru in 2022, Mercari India serves as a crucial technology hub for the Mercari Group. Leveraging the rich and diverse tech talent in India, we primarily collaborate closely with our development hub in Japan to drive engineering development for Mercaris applications. Having grown to an organization of approximately 100+ members over about Four years since its inception, Mercari India aims to evolve into an even stronger engineering organization that spearheads technological innovation for the entire group. This will be achieved by further enhancing our engineering capabilities and promoting AI initiatives that reflect Indias cutting-edge technology and knowledge.

Our Culture

To achieve our mission at Mercari, our organisation and each of our employees share the same values and perspectives.

Our individual guidelines for action are defined by our four values:

  • Go Bold
  • All for One
  • Be a Pro
  • Move Fast

Our organisation is also shaped by our four foundations:

  • Sustainability
  • Diversity & Inclusion
  • Trust & Openness
  • Well-being for Performance

Regardless of how big Mercari gets, the culture will remain essential to achieving our mission and something we want to preserve throughout our organisation.

We invite you to read the "Mercari Culture Doc," which summarizes the behaviours and mindset shared by Mercari and its employees. We continue to build an environment where all of our members of diverse backgrounds are accepted and recognised, and where they can thrive while holding dear to Mercari s culture.

  • Define the product vision, roadmap, priorities, and measurable outcomes for CS and TnS
  • Identify opportunities using customer feedback, operational insights, and data
  • Define success metrics, baselines, guardrails, and post-launch measurement plans
  • Balance customer experience, operational efficiency, risk, and business priorities

  • Manage projects from discovery through development, rollout, adoption, and iteration

Working with engineering
  • Write specs that survive the codebase, the kind engineers trust.

The hard part, the part most product managers dodge
  • Design for the failure mode, not just the demo: the edge cases, the false positives, the long tail, the last twenty percent.
  • Ship against evals and real numbers, not a spec that is either met or not.
  • Build the guardrails and the fallback that turn a demo into something an enterprise will actually run.


Outcomes, not output
  • Tie the work to a number the business actually feels.
  • Turn what works once into something repeatable.
  • Say plainly what is on track and what is slipping, every week.

  • You need the product handed to you before you can care about it.
  • You think generative AI is the whole of AI.
  • You count features shipped instead of the number you moved.
  • You go quiet at eighty percent instead of owning the last twenty.
  • You need a title to feel credible, or you think a title is enough.

This is a product management role first: the successful candidate will own the roadmap end to end, from strategic direction through market validation. Experience in clinical trial operations sharpens product judgment but is not the primary qualification for this role.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the product strategy and roadmap for the clinical trials line, determining what is built, in what sequence, backed with evidence.
• Translate real, ambiguous, operational problems sourced from sites, sponsors, and CROs into requirements that engineering can build from directly.
• Lead the development of accelerated MVPs, prioritizing speed to a testable product over a complete one.
• Apply an agentic AI lens to product decisions, identifying where autonomous or AI-assisted workflows outperform manual processes and where they do not.

• Represent Avegen's clinical trials product line externally, including briefings with industry analysts and influencers, in support of market recognition as a best-in-breed solution.

Required Qualifications

• 5 - 8 years of product management experience, with demonstrated ownership of a product roadmap end to end, from strategy through launch, in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.

• Experience making prioritization decisions with incomplete information, supported by clear, evidence-based reasoning. • Working fluency with agentic AI product patterns, including where they add genuine value and where they do not.
• Experience taking a product to market, including positioning, pricing decisions, and representing the product to analysts and customers.

Preferred Qualifications

• Direct clinical trial operations experience, or proximity to it: prior work as a Clinical Research Associate, Clinical Trial Manager, or Site Operations Lead, within a CRO or sponsor organization, or experience building a product for this sector.

About Refold AI 

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants. 

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

What you'll do:

Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?
You will draw that line repeatedly, and the answer will keep changing. How do you price outcomes instead of usage, in an industry that has only ever paid for hours? You will own that question commercially and build the model around it. What does it mean for a platform to get smarter across customers without leaking what any one customer knows?
You will define what learning looks like at the system level.
How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on
integrations running without anyone watching? You will own that experience end to end.
When something breaks in production for an enterprise customer, who gets told, what do they see, and what can they do about it? You will design that judgment layer.

What we're looking for:

You have shipped something on your own. A side project, a tool, anything you took from zero to working. We are building systems with real complexity. We need someone who has felt the difference between a decision made in a doc and a decision made in code.
You are technically grounded. You do not write the code, but you understand the structure, the trade-offs, and the failure modes. When engineering says a change costs 40% more compute, you know what that means downstream.
You think in constraints. When you look at a feature request, the first question is what breaks if we build this, not what we could do with it. Edge cases are not polish. They are often the product.
You write, not deck. Specs, trade-off docs, design decisions. If you cannot write a crisp two-page spec, the feature is not ready to build.
You push back. If the scoping is underspecified, say so. If the deadline is not realistic, say so. Disagree clearly and commit once a decision is made

Experience

5+ years in product in the B2B software industry
At least 2 of those years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer tool.
Comfortable with distributed systems concepts: queues, retries, schema versioning, idempotency
Track record of shipping things that were actually hard, not feature additions on a stable roadmap
Degree from a top-tier institution, or hands-on product experience at a company known for building hard things. One or the other, not neither.

Director (C15) - Head of Product and Engineering

Location: Pune (Hybrid)

Line of Business: Compliance Technology / Enterprise Technology

About The Role

Are you a product engineering leader who excels at driving massive platform consolidations, leading high-performing global teams, and solving complex distributed systems challenges? Do you believe in solving complex problem through technology simplification and modernisation?

At Citi, we are executing a bold, multi-year technology modernisation strategy. A critical pillar of this transformation is the unification of our global compliance enterprise workflow and case management systems. As the Head of Product and Engineering, you will be the strategic engineering leader and product visionary responsible for driving the consolidation, modernisation, and scaling of our global compliance case management platforms.

In this dual-hatted role, you will:

Lead Global Case Management & Workflow Platforms: Direct a globally distributed engineering organisation tasked with building and scaling our unified, high-throughput enterprise workflow and decisioning platforms.

Serve as the India Site Lead: Act as the senior technology executive for our regional engineering hub in India, driving talent strategy, engineering culture, and operational excellence across the site.

This is a high-visibility, executive-level role reporting directly to the Managing Director, Global Head of Product and Engineering.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Strategy ,Platform Unification and Product Management
Drive Platform Consolidation: Define and execute the technical strategy to consolidate disparate legacy workflow and case management systems into a single, modern, global platform.
Architectural Modernization: Lead the transition of core platforms to a cloud-native, microservices-based, and event-driven architecture capable of processing millions of complex events daily with sub-second latency.
AI & Automation Integration: Partner with AI/ML research teams to embed intelligent routing, automated document processing, and machine learning-driven decision support systems into the core workflow engine.
Technical Governance: Establish and enforce robust architectural standards, API designs, and data schemas that ensure long-term platform extensibility and maintainability.
Product leadership: Thought leader and ability to wear the product hat. Ability to drive strategic product decision along with key stakeholders
Global Engineering Leadership & Execution
Manage Globally Distributed Teams: Lead, inspire, and scale a multi-disciplinary engineering organization(75+)
Foster Engineering Excellence: Establish rigorous standards for code quality, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and comprehensive observability (monitoring, tracing, logging) to ensure 99.999% platform availability.
Operational & Financial Management: Oversee financial planning, resource allocation, vendor management, and operational budgets for your global engineering organisation.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Operations, Risk, and senior business executives to align engineering roadmaps with business outcomes.
India Site Leadership
Site Strategy & Growth: Act as the senior executive and site lead for the regional engineering hub in India. Drive local talent acquisition, retention, and career development programs.
Culture & Collaboration: Build a vibrant, inclusive, and high-performance engineering culture that mirrors the best practices of top-tier product technology companies.
Local Governance: Ensure compliance with local regulations, operational standards, and corporate policies.

Our Target Tech Stack & Architecture

We are actively migrating our platforms to a modern, cloud-native stack:

Backend & Microservices: Go, Java (Spring Boot), Python, gRPC, REST APIs
Frontend & Workflows: React, Angular, TypeScript, Modern BPMN/Workflow Engines (e.g., Temporal, Camunda, Flowable)
Data & Event Streaming: Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch
Cloud & Infrastructure: Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, AWS, Service Mesh (Istio)
AI/ML & Analytics: Multi-LLM integrations via secure internal gateways, Vector Databases, Python-based ML pipelines

What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)

Basic Qualifications:

Experience: 15+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 5+ years in an engineering leadership role (Director, Senior Engineering Manager, or equivalent) at Product-Engineering first setup
Platform Unification: Proven track record of successfully leading large-scale platform consolidations, legacy migrations, or enterprise-wide system unifications.
Distributed Systems: Deep expertise in designing and operating high-availability, low-latency, and highly secure distributed systems at massive scale.
Global Leadership: Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams of 80+ engineers, including direct management of engineering managers and principal architects.
Site Leadership: Proven experience leading a regional engineering site or hub, with a strong track record of building local talent pipelines and fostering a strong engineering culture.

Preferred Qualifications:

Domain Knowledge: Experience in compliance, sanctions, transaction risk, anti-money laundering (AML), fraud detection, or high-scale transactional risk systems is highly desirable but not mandatory. We value core engineering leadership and platform-building capabilities above specific domain experience.
Workflow & BPMN Expertise: Familiarity with modern workflow orchestration engines (e.g., Temporal, Camunda) and complex state-machine design.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

Why Join Citi?

Unprecedented Scale & Impact: We secure and facilitate the global financial system. The platforms you unify will protect trillions of dollars in daily transactions from financial crime and regulatory risk.
True Autonomy: You will have the mandate, budget, and executive backing to make critical architectural and organizational decisions to achieve our platform unification goals.
Modern Developer Ecosystem: Leverage Citi's state-of-the-art internal developer platforms, including our secure GenAI gateway and modern serverless application frameworks, to accelerate delivery.

And many more reasons…

Company overview:

TraceLink is the world’s largest Agentic Business Network, enabling life sciences and healthcare companies to build and manage a scalable digital workforce of governed, no-code AI agents that execute and coordinate mission-critical supply chain operations alongside human teams. Powered by the Integrate-Once™ OPUS platform, TraceLink links more than 300,000 network participants, enabling multi-enterprise processes at global scale.

Founded in 2009 with the simple mission of protecting patients, today Tracelink has 5 global offices, over 800 employees and more than 1700 customers in over 60 countries around the world. Our expanding product suite continues to protect patients and now also enhances multi-enterprise collaboration through innovative new applications such as MINT.

Tracelink is recognized as an industry leader by Gartner and IDC, and for having a great company culture by Comparably.

Position Overview

The OPUS Platform Knowledge Expert is a platform and subject-matter expert responsible for developing, structuring, and maintaining the messaging, positioning, and core knowledge artifacts that power TraceLink’s OPUS Platform go-to-market execution, field enablement, and AI-driven experiences for both customer personas and TraceLink field teams.

The OPUS Platform Knowledge Expert serves as the global owner of the OPUS platform capability areas—such as Opus Reports and Dashboards, Opus Solution Environment, Solution Catalog, user administration, metadata management, etc.—and builds the messaging frameworks, insights, and artifacts that support executive-level conversations across all relevant customer segments.

This is a unique role combining platform expertise, industry context, strategic storytelling, and knowledge artifact creation, and curation for executive buyer experiences.

Responsibilities

OPUS Platform Domain Expertise

Serve as TraceLink’s subject-matter expert for the OPUS Platform, supporting Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Content, Sales Enablement, and Sales teams. 
Build a deep understanding of OPUS Platform architecture and capabilities, and how the platform enables TraceLink solutions and customer business outcomes. 
Translate complex platform concepts into clear business value for executive, technical, and operational personas. 
Participate in select cross-functional initiatives, roadmap discussions, and executive or customer engagements as required. 

Strategic Narratives, Messaging, and Positioning

Develop strategic narratives, messaging, and positioning for the OPUS Platform targeting executive and technical decision-makers (e.g., CIO, CDO, CTO, Enterprise Architects). 
Articulate the OPUS Platform value proposition as the foundation for TraceLink solutions, ecosystem participation, and digital network effects. 
Create and maintain competitive differentiation against alternative platforms, point solutions, and legacy integration approaches. 
Continuously validate and refine messaging through regular engagement with field teams, customers, and prospects. 

AI and LLM Buying & Enablement Experiences

Build and maintain an LLM-ready OPUS Platform messaging framework with modular, metadata-tagged positioning, capabilities, and value narratives. 
Ensure taxonomy alignment, version control, and canonical terminology so platform messaging is consistent, current, and consumable by AI systems. 
Curate and govern the OPUS Platform knowledge corpus to ensure accurate, secure, and authoritative AI-generated outputs. 
Design executive- and architect-ready LLM experiences using prompt patterns, scenarios, and platform value-story templates for internal enablement and external buyer interactions. 

Deliverables and Key Knowledge Artifacts

Create and maintain a standard set of OPUS Platform knowledge artifacts that drive executive conversations, field enablement, and LLM-driven experiences, including but not limited to:

OPUS Platform Messaging & Positioning Playbook documenting platform vision, value pillars, persona-based messaging, and competitive differentiation. 
LLM-Ready Platform Messaging Framework & Metadata Schema defining modular platform message objects, taxonomies, and canonical terminology for AI ingestion. 
Curated OPUS Platform Knowledge Library, including architecture overviews, capability descriptions, platform services, extensibility patterns, security and compliance models, and glossary of terms. 
Executive Platform Narrative Decks tailored for CIO, CTO, CDO, and VP-level personas, highlighting business value, scalability, interoperability, and long-term platform ROI. 
Competitive Platform Landscape & Differentiation Dossiers comparing OPUS to alternative platforms, middleware, and integration strategies with scenario-based differentiation and objection handling. 
LLM Prompt Patterns, Conversation Flows, and Experience Blueprints enabling consistent, high-credibility AI-driven conversations about the OPUS Platform. 
Field Enablement Knowledge Packs including platform talk tracks, architecture narratives, use-case mappings, objection handling, and LLM-powered microlearning assets. 

Skills And Qualifications

10 + years of experience in product management, product marketing, platform strategy, solution consulting, or analyst roles with exposure to enterprise platforms, data networks, or SaaS ecosystems. 
Strong understanding of platform concepts such as APIs, data models, interoperability, extensibility, security, and scalability. 
Exceptional writing and presentation skills, particularly for senior executive and technical audiences. 
Ability to distill complex, technical platform capabilities into clear, structured business narratives. 
Experience producing strategic content such as platform briefs, architecture narratives, whitepapers, or competitive analyses. 
Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), conversational AI, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems. 
Experience in structuring, tagging, and governing content for AI/ML consumption is a plus. 
Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Solution Consulting, Value Engineering, and Services teams. 
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience required. 
Travel: Ability to travel up to 25% as required by business needs. 

Please see the Tracelink Privacy Policy for more information on how Tracelink processes your personal information during the recruitment process and, if applicable based on your location, how you can exercise your privacy rights. If you have questions about this privacy notice or need to contact us in connection with your personal data, including any requests to exercise your legal rights referred to at the end of this notice, please contact Candidate-Privacy@tracelink.com.

Overview

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

The Services Business represents over a third of Mastercard revenues and is a key differentiator for Mastercard. Services is critical for the sustained, long-term growth of Mastercard.

Within the Services organization, this role sits within the Business & Markets Insights (BMI) organization. The Business & Market Insights vertical is focused on creating products and solutions that create value for customers through Analytics, Insights, Business Experimentation, and Payment Consulting & Innovation.

Under BMI, Payment Performance Intelligence Program's Global Product Management team is seeking an accomplished technology-focused Product Manager to support the evolution of its products to include AI intelligence. Job Description - AVP - Product | Snapmint

About Snapmint
Founded by IIT Bombay alumni (Nalin Agrawal, Anil Gelra, Abhineet Sawa), Snapmint is building India’s most loved payment brand. We pioneered Pay in 3 through UPI and are also home to India’s leading 0% EMI e-commerce app — giving millions of Indians the freedom to shop now and pay in monthly instalments, with no extra cost and no credit card required.

Today, Snapmint has crossed 50M+ app downloads and is the preferred payment partner for 2,000+ leading consumer brands, including Zepto, ixigo, Adani, District Store, Titan and many more. We’re on a mission to make fair, transparent credit accessible to Young India - and make payments simple, enjoyable and worry-free.
Headquartered in Mumbai, with offices across major metros including Bengaluru, Gurugram, Delhi and Jaipur, we’re building at the intersection of commerce, credit, technology and culture. If you want to work on a product used by millions, build a brand people genuinely love, and help redefine how the next generation of India pays and spends you’ll fit right in.
